adjudication.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts, `blacklistedGuestEmails` is built as a lowercase list (`split(...).map(email => email.toLowerCase())`), but the filter compares it against the raw `guest` string: `!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)`. Since `guest` is not normalized (lowercased/trimmed), mixed-case inputs like `Victim@Example.com` can bypass a blacklist entry `victim@example.com`. This is a real, diff-grounded correctness/security bug.
